changed_files.description: Implemented get_object_deep_size, run_memory_analysis, membership microbenchmarks, rank/horizon/build scaling, and memory CLI subcommand.
Comprehensive unit test suite verifying W4-034-C01 through C07 requirements.

artifacts.description: Report detailing reference tensor payloads (Float32: 1,136,072 bytes, Float64: 2,272,120 bytes), process peak RSS context, attributable memory per method, and membership microbenchmarks.
Scaling analysis report covering rank scaling (k=1..32), horizon scaling (H=1..32), and build budget scaling (1e-4..1e-1).

requirement_evidence.evidence: Counted owned parameter/buffer/domain/certificate/cache bytes recursively. Isolated baseline core (1,136,072 bytes) and avoided double-counting shared reference model objects across wrappers (M01 wrapper attributable bytes < 2KB). Verified by test_w4_034_c01_baseline_and_owned_byte_separation.

Recorded process peak RSS (446,088 KB) with explicit clarification that process memory includes Python runtime, PyTorch backend, and frozen HAPT dataset arrays, not attributable to adapter cache. Verified by test_w4_034_c02_process_peak_rss_scope_clarification.

Evaluated membership microbenchmarks across 1,000 iterations for full 768 coordinate box, tail 384 fixed-prefix, latent PCA k=16, and residual norm checks. Documented Theta(m) worst-case complexity regardless of early rejection or SIMD execution. Verified by test_w4_034_c03_membership_microbenchmarks.

Evaluated scaling sweeps strictly adhering to validation-declared protocol caps across rank k in {1, 2, 4, 8, 16, 32}, horizon H in {1, 2, 4, 8, 16, 32}, and build budgets {1e-4, 1e-3, 1e-2, 1e-1}. Stated protocol extension requirement. Verified by test_w4_034_c04_scaling_sweeps.

Logged coordinates read (768 for full, 384 for tail/incremental), workspace allocations, and amortization scopes (per_query vs per_window_stream). Verified by test_w4_034_c05_coordinates_read_and_amortization_scope.

Explicitly set unmeasured telemetry (GPU memory bytes, energy joules, dynamic workspace RSS delta) to null with sound engineering reasons. Avoided extrapolating memory from disk file size. Verified by test_w4_034_c06_unmeasured_telemetry_null_with_reasons.

Tested payload accounting against aliased buffers (confirming no duplication), verified bytes/ns/ms units, and retained metadata for all 17 registered methods (including M14 and M15 marked AUDITED_UNSUPPORTED). Verified by test_w4_034_c07_all_17_methods_retention_and_no_double_counting.

limitations: Sub-millisecond dynamic heap workspace RSS delta cannot be reliably isolated due to Python allocator fragmentation; exact tensor payloads and recursive object deep sizes are reported instead.
Hardware GPU and energy instrumentation are null because execution is restricted to single-thread CPU isolation.
